swing.name: Two-hand swing
cues: Hinge at the hips; keep your back stable.
Drive with the hips; arms guide the bell.
Stop when the bell no longer floats from hip power.
swing.avoid: Do not turn the swing into a squat or shoulder raise.

squat.name: Goblet squat
cues: Hold the bell close and brace.
Sit between the hips with heels planted.
Stand tall without leaning backward.
squat.avoid: Reduce depth or load if you lose control.

press.name: Single-arm strict press
cues: Rack with wrist straight and ribs stacked.
Press without a knee dip or sideways lean.
Lower under control; train both sides.
press.avoid: Do not press through shoulder pain.

row.name: Single-arm row
cues: Hinge with a stable torso.
Pull elbow toward your back pocket.
Lower without twisting.
row.avoid: Avoid rotating the trunk to finish the pull.

clean.name: Single-arm clean
cues: Start with a controlled hike and hip drive.
Keep the bell close and guide it around the hand.
Finish in a quiet rack without forearm impact.
clean.avoid: Stop if the bell repeatedly crashes into your arm.

carry.name: Suitcase carry
cues: Stand tall with one bell at your side.
Walk slowly without leaning.
Change sides and match the time.
carry.avoid: Do not continue if grip or posture fails.

cast.name: Two-hand shield cast
cues: Begin with a light club and clear space.
Move smoothly around the head within comfortable range.
Return to the front under control; reverse direction.
cast.avoid: Avoid forcing the shoulders or striking the body.

circles.name: Two-hand club circles
cues: Brace and keep the feet planted.
Draw a controlled circle on each side.
Match the arc and tempo in both directions.
circles.avoid: Do not chase speed at the expense of control.

front.name: Two-hand club front swing
cues: Stand stable with hands secure.
Swing with a smooth hip-driven rhythm.
Control the return rather than letting the club pull you.

snatch.name: Single-arm snatch
cues: Only practice a familiar snatch with a controlled overhead lockout.
Start with the weaker side; match the stronger side.
Stop if hand skin, grip or overhead control deteriorates.
snatch.avoid: Do not learn a snatch by testing a heavy or unfamiliar load.

doublePress.name: Double clean and press
cues: Use a matched pair you can rack and press with control.
Keep the trunk stable and lower into a quiet rack.
doublePress.avoid: No maximum attempts or grinding repetitions.

doubleSquat.name: Double front squat
cues: Use a familiar, secure double rack.
Keep depth and bracing repeatable.
doubleSquat.avoid: Stop when rack position or controlled depth is lost.

getup.name: Turkish get-up
cues: Use a familiar load and deliberate fixation at each transition.
Alternate complete single repetitions; start with your weaker side.
Record total time under load and actual completed reps on each side.
getup.avoid: Stop safely if overhead control or a transition deteriorates; do not rush to meet a time goal.

clubInside.name: Single-arm club inside circle
cues: Begin from a controlled order position with clear space.
Inside means the hand moves toward the center line.
Match both sides and keep the club under control through hand changes.
clubInside.avoid: Do not replace the two-hand learning foundation with a heavy single-arm attempt.

clubOutside.name: Single-arm club outside circle
cues: Outside means the hand moves away from the center line.
Use a familiar light club and stable controlled movement.
Match inside/outside practice and both sides; do not chase speed.
clubOutside.avoid: Stop if the club path, catch or hand change becomes uncontrolled.

clubShield.name: Single-arm club shield cast
cues: Build from the familiar two-hand cast before removing support.
Rotate, push, pull and catch with a controlled return to order.
Keep the club off the ground between sets only while technique stays clean.
clubShield.avoid: Do not force a shoulder range or continue after grip or control is lost.

getupFloor.name: Get-up floor press practice
cues: Use the familiar floor setup and support the return with the other hand.
Keep a controlled wrist and forearm position; match both sides.
getupFloor.avoid: Use a familiar light load; stop when support, position or controlled return is lost.

getupElbow.name: Get-up press to elbow
cues: Press, roll and rise onto the elbow with deliberate support.
Reverse the sequence with control and match both sides.
getupElbow.avoid: Use a familiar light load; stop when support, position or controlled return is lost.

getupHand.name: Get-up press to hand
cues: Press, roll, elbow, hand; stabilize rather than repeatedly moving the support hand.
Return through elbow and shoulders with control.
getupHand.avoid: Use a familiar light load; stop when support, position or controlled return is lost.

getupHipPass.name: Get-up hip-pass practice
cues: From stable hand support, lift the hip and bring the knee back in line with the hand.
Orient upright, then reverse deliberately; this drill omits the final stand.
getupHipPass.avoid: Use a familiar light load; stop when support, position or controlled return is lost.

clubInsidePendulum.name: Single-arm club inside pendulum
cues: Inside travels toward the center line; use the supported two-hand rehearsal first.
Rotate through a controlled path, then return to order.
clubInsidePendulum.avoid: Use a familiar light club and reviewed technique; stop rather than force rotation, grip or a catch.

clubOutsidePendulum.name: Single-arm club outside pendulum
cues: Outside travels away from the center line.
Rehearse with two hands, then remove support only with familiar control.
clubOutsidePendulum.avoid: Use a familiar light club and reviewed technique; stop rather than force rotation, grip or a catch.

clubFrontPullover.name: Single-arm club front pullover
cues: Rehearse the familiar straight-back, straight-forward pullover.
Keep the return to order controlled before adding rotation.
clubFrontPullover.avoid: Use a familiar light club and reviewed technique; stop rather than force rotation, grip or a catch.

clubOutsidePullover.name: Single-arm club outside pullover
cues: Use the familiar front-to-back pullover foundation first.
The hand travels outside and past the same-side ear; return under control.
clubOutsidePullover.avoid: Use a familiar light club and reviewed technique; stop rather than force rotation, grip or a catch.

clubInsidePullover.name: Single-arm club inside pullover three count
cues: Build from front and outside pullovers before the inside variation.
Use three deliberate counts and demonstrate control before the return.
clubInsidePullover.avoid: Use a familiar light club and reviewed technique; stop rather than force rotation, grip or a catch.

hingePractice.name: Unloaded hip-hinge practice
cues: Rehearse the unloaded hinge with deliberate bracing and controlled return.
Use the pattern as preparation rather than a maximum-effort test.
hingePractice.avoid: Stop when bracing or comfortable movement is lost.

pushup.name: Push-up EMOM volume
cues: Keep the trunk stable and use a clean, controlled repetition.
Stop the set when the clean movement standard is lost.
Use the configured conservative baseline; the app does not ask for daily maximum attempts.
pushup.avoid: Do not turn incomplete or poor-technique reps into progression credit.

hipDropTwoHand.name: Two-hand hip-drop practice
cues: Start standing, lower under control and finish by standing again.
Keep both hands flat, knees close to wrists and use quiet step-step transitions.
Lower the hip and thigh to the ground; keep the supporting shoulder controlled.
hipDropTwoHand.avoid: Do not jump, buck the hips or let the feet creep away from the hands.

hipDropSingleHand.name: Single-hand hip-drop practice
cues: Use the familiar two-hand setup; return the free hand to the same spot.
Sit the hip and thigh down, bring the free elbow toward the belly and look at the hand.
Keep the supporting shoulder away from the ear; exhale on the hip touch and practice both sides.
hipDropSingleHand.avoid: Do not lift into an unsupported advanced variation or continue with shoulder pain.

bearSquat.name: Bear-squat mobility practice
cues: Find hand distance from a comfortable kneeling position.
Move from knees down toward straight legs with stable hands and feet.
Keep elbows straight and move deliberately within comfortable range; return to the same knee position.
bearSquat.avoid: Do not force range, speed or an endurance target after control deteriorates.

deadlift.name: Two-hand kettlebell deadlift
cues: Place the bell between the feet and hinge back with controlled alignment.
Stand with controlled bracing, glute engagement and a stable trunk.
Return the bell to the ground under control; use a familiar manageable load.
deadlift.avoid: Do not turn the lift into a swing or increase weight before clean practice and deliberate review.
